page0.text: A tepid breeze caresses my cheeks.

page1.text:
We come to the end of the passage, which opens into a larger cavern.
It's as wide as the school grounds.
I can't see the ceiling in the murk, but it could be as high as ten meters.

page2.text:
There are no signs of life.
The forgotten underground wasteland reminds me of the pictures of the moon's surface I saw in books, long ago.
There...
stands Saber, waiting for us.

page3.text:
She's the only one in the cave.
I don't see Sakura, Zouken, or Assassin.
Only the darkened swordswoman blocks our path.

page4.text:
"...Saber."
"........."
She wouldn't have anything to say to me.

page5.text:
Of course not.
Saber's only job is to eliminate intruders.
She's the gatekeeper and executioner here.
She's the strongest Servant protecting Sakura, and she could take us both alone.

page6.text:
"...Hmph. Doesn't look like we'll be able to talk our way through."
Tohsaka arms herself with the Jeweled Sword she kept behind her waist, keeping her stance low.

page7.text:
She intends to attack from the front.
I don't know what powers that sword has, but she seems to think it'll work in a clash against Saber.

page8.text:
But it won't go well.
I know Saber, so there are ways to deal with her. We shouldn't reveal our only secret weapon while Zouken and Assassin could still be waiting—

page9.text:
"Tohsaka, wait! Saber is—"
"Rin. I have no reason to fight you. Take care not to point that sword at me. I would be violating Sakura's orders if I killed you here."

page10.text:
"...!"
Saber's quiet voice is the same as ever. It stops Rin in her tracks.
Tohsaka and I both know what that means.

page11.text:
"...What do you mean? Aren't you the gatekeeper here, Saber?"
"Yes. I will eliminate any who attempt to pass.
That was Sakura's order. But..."
"I'm an exception. She wants to see me?"
Saber nods wordlessly.

page12.text:
"...Okay. Sakura's serious, then."
She murmurs briefly.
After a big sigh, Tohsaka walks toward Saber.

page13.text:
"Tohsaka."
"Sorry. That's how it is, so I'm going on ahead."
Tohsaka boldly walks past Saber.
Just before she blends into the dark...

page14.text: "Shirou. I don't know what will happen to you, but I trust you. Make sure you live up to that."

page15.text:
"Huh?"
...Hold on.
I'm not sure what I'm supposed to do with that vague statement, not that my brain is working very well right now.

page16.text:
"I-I'm saying that I don't want you to complain when you show up after everything's over! ...If you want to save Sakura, then don't take too long."
Tohsaka's long hair whips through the air, and she disappears into the depths of the cave without looking back.

page17.text:
...
...Thanks, Tohsaka.
That boosted my spirits.
In other words, telling me to come before she settles the score with Sakura was her roundabout way of cheering me on.

page18.text:
"That is impossible. You will die here, Shirou."
"...!"

page19.text:
Saber's bloodlust swells.
Tohsaka's gone, leaving only me.
I suppose that in this situation, Saber doesn't need to hide her hostility anymore.

page20.text: "Did I hear you correctly? You said that you would only kill those who attempt to pass. If he stays here, you should not attack him."

page21.text:
"If he stays there, yes.
But he will try to pass. He knows he cannot beat me, but he still needs to go.
Am I wrong, Rider?"
"No, you did serve him once, Saber.
You must be quite familiar with his character."

page22.text:
...Saber narrows her eyes.
She holds a black-dyed sacred sword in her hands.
She's coming.
Me or Rider.
If either of us take so much as a step forward, Saber will rush in to cut us down with a single blow.

page23.text:
"...You won't let us pass, no matter what, Saber?"
"Enough! I told you that this is my role now."
I grasp the holy shroud covering my left arm.
...Saber doesn't show a hint of doubt.
We're enemies now.
That's the undeniable truth that I saw for myself in the forest that night.

page24.text:
And I answer...
"...I see. Then we'll destroy you."
I have to accept it.

page25.text:
...
"I'm going to save Sakura. You're in the way."
Saber isn't my only enemy.
I still need to deal with Assassin and Zouken, who's responsible for all of this.
I can't let this take up any more of our time.

page26.text:
"Shirou, get behind me. I will engage Saber, as planned."
Rider pushes me behind her while removing her blindfold.

page27.text:
Saber raises her sword.
The tip of her sword is already keenly focused on Rider.

page28.text:
"Don't be ridiculous. I said we'd take her together. Rider, you can't..."
"I cannot defeat her, but I can suppress her. Fortunately, Saber has no attribute that protects against Mystic Eyes.
I cannot petrify her because her magical energy exceeds mine, but I can weigh her down. I should be able to hold out against her for two minutes at maximum effort."

page29.text:
Rider's eyes focus on Saber.
They can turn everything they see to stone, and they can weaken Saber temporarily.

page30.text:
"I will create an opportunity. Stay still and make sure you don't miss it."
"Rider..."
"I am off. My life is in your hands, Shirou."

page31.text:
Rider vanishes.
She charges the dark knight at extreme speed, raising a gust of wind.

page32.text:
Human eyesight can't even perceive Rider's godlike speed.
Saber casually knocks her back.

page33.text:
"Very well. I'll erase you first, Rider."
An enormous pressure suffuses the cave.
The black swordsman smiles coldly, and calmly begins to move.
